name: The Galactic Harem Handbook
source:
Unleash your desires and embark on a path of conquest in a captivating visual novel that immerses you in a world of power, seduction, and galactic domination.

As the enigmatic Galactic Emperor, your journey begins as a lone conqueror, building your empire from the ground up. From tree-dwelling humanoids to cavewomen, small tribes, and even advanced civilizations, expand your influence and harem exponentially, leaving no frontier untouched.

Harness the power of cloning, amassing an army of loyal clones of yourself to aid in your quest for dominance. Make strategic choices, build relationships, and navigate complex political landscapes to solidify your position as the supreme ruler of the galaxy.

Experience the thrill of romance and desire as you encounter a diverse cast of captivating characters. Each henchwoman in your harem possesses unique traits, strengths, and weaknesses, offering intriguing storylines and opportunities for intimate connections.

Immerse yourself in a visually stunning universe, brought to life with exquisite artwork and cosmic landscapes that evoke the grandeur of your galactic domain.

Prepare to conquer, seduce, and dominate as you ascend to the pinnacle of power. The galaxy awaits your command, and the fate of countless worlds lies in your hands. Can you master "The Harem Handbook" and establish your legacy as the ultimate Galactic Emperor?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2442100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这部引人入胜的视觉小说中释放你的欲望，踏上征服之路，让你沉浸在一个充满力量、诱惑和银河统治的世界中。

作为神秘的银河皇帝，你的旅程从一个孤独的征服者开始，从头开始建立你的帝国。从树上的类人生物到穴居女性、小部落，甚至先进的文明，成倍地扩大你的影响力和后宫，不留任何边界。

利用克隆的力量，聚集一支忠诚的克隆大军来帮助你追求统治地位。做出战略选择，建立关系，驾驭复杂的政治格局，以巩固你作为银河系最高统治者的地位。

当你遇到各种各样的迷人角色时，体验浪漫和欲望的快感。你后宫中的每个女追随者都拥有独特的特质、优点和缺点，提供有趣的故事情节和建立亲密联系的机会。

沉浸在视觉上令人惊叹的宇宙中，精美的​​艺术品和宇宙景观栩栩如生，唤起你银河领域的宏伟。

准备好征服、诱惑和统治，登上权力的顶峰。银河系等待着你的指挥，无数世界的命运掌握在你的手中。你能掌握《后宫手册》并奠定你作为终极银河皇帝的遗产吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2442100/]Steam[/url]]
